title: Abduction and implant prevalence estimates

tellings.quote: Well, the people that they implant uh they they've they've abducted about 3% of the American population according to Dr. L.

plain: About 3% of Americans have been abducted by the beings who put implants in people, says Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants found in human bodies. He tells Michels the number comes from a doctor named Roger Leir, whom he calls Dr. L. If that were so, millions of people would have been taken.
